sql_calls.sql:
SELECT sku, gtin, name, pack, case_units, case_kg, flow, dc_slot, price_inr, cost_inr
FROM store.products
WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%atta%' OR lower(pack) LIKE '%5 kg%'
ORDER BY sku;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS source, date::text AS ts, sku, units_sold::text AS value1, revenue_inr::text AS value2, NULL::text AS extra
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', audit_ts::text, sku, status, NULL, NULL
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', date::text, sku, book_on_hand_close::text, NULL, NULL
FROM store.inventory_book
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', count_ts::text, sku, book_before::text, counted::text, trigger || '; adjustment=' || adjustment::text
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND count_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND count_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY source, ts;

SELECT 'pos_lines' AS source, MIN(bill_ts)::text AS first_ts, MAX(bill_ts)::text AS last_ts, COUNT(*)::text AS n, SUM(qty)::text AS units
FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'daily_sales', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text, SUM(units_sold)::text
FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text, NULL
FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text, NULL
FROM store.forecasts WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text, NULL
FROM store.inventory_book WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', MIN(count_ts)::text, MAX(count_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text, NULL
FROM store.stock_counts WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store_orders', MIN(created_ts)::text, MAX(created_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text, SUM(units)::text
FROM store.store_orders WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_offs', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text, SUM(units)::text
FROM store.write_offs WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG';

SELECT audit_ts, sku, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT 'pos_lines_june' AS metric, COUNT(*)::text AS rows_or_days, SUM(qty)::text AS units, SUM(line_amount)::text AS amount
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'daily_sales_june', COUNT(*)::text, SUM(units_sold)::text, SUM(revenue_inr)::text
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits_june', COUNT(*)::text,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf')::text,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2)::text
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';

SELECT date, forecast_units_per_day, sigma, reorder_point, order_up_to,
       book_on_hand, on_order, ordered_units, method
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY date;

SELECT count_ts, book_before, counted, adjustment, trigger
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY count_ts;

sql_calls.sql:
SELECT date, forecast_units_per_day, sigma, reorder_point, order_up_to,
       book_on_hand, on_order, ordered_units, method
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY date;

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold)
   FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
     AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS bags_sold_daily_sales,
  (SELECT SUM(qty)
   FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
     AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS bags_sold_pos_lines,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) AS total_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_shelf_availability_pct
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';

SELECT SUM(units_sold) AS bags_sold
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND date < DATE '2026-07-01';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) AS total_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_shelf_availability_pct
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';
